query:
// One row per passer for the selected season and season type. Players traded
// mid-season have several team rows; they are summed here and rates recomputed.
DEFINE
    VAR __Season = "2025"
    VAR __SeasonType = "REG"
    VAR __MinVolume = 200
    VAR __Grouped =
        SUMMARIZECOLUMNS (
            'Player Season Summary'[player_key],
            'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
            TREATAS ( { __Season }, 'Player Season Summary'[season] ),
            TREATAS ( { __SeasonType }, 'Player Season Summary'[season_type] ),
            "@Pos", MAX ( 'Player Season Summary'[position] ),
            "@Teams", CONCATENATEX ( VALUES ( 'Player Season Summary'[team_key] ), 'Player Season Summary'[team_key], "/" ),
            "@Dropbacks", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[passing_dropbacks] ),
            "@Att", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[attempts] ),
            "@Cmp", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[completions] ),
            "@Yds", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[passing_yards] ),
            "@TD", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[passing_tds] ),
            "@INT", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[interceptions] ),
            "@EPA", SUM ( 'Player Season Summary'[passing_epa] ),
            "@CpoeWeighted",
                SUMX (
                    FILTER ( 'Player Season Summary', NOT ISBLANK ( 'Player Season Summary'[avg_cpoe] ) ),
                    'Player Season Summary'[avg_cpoe] * 'Player Season Summary'[attempts]
                ),
            "@CpoeAtt",
                SUMX (
                    FILTER ( 'Player Season Summary', NOT ISBLANK ( 'Player Season Summary'[avg_cpoe] ) ),
                    'Player Season Summary'[attempts]
                )
        )
EVALUATE
SELECTCOLUMNS (
    FILTER ( __Grouped, [@Dropbacks] >= __MinVolume ),
    "Player", 'Player Season Summary'[player_name],
    "Position", [@Pos],
    "Team", [@Teams],
    "Dropbacks", [@Dropbacks],
    "Yards", [@Yds],
    "TD", [@TD],
    "INT", [@INT],
    "CompPct", DIVIDE ( [@Cmp], [@Att] ),
    "CPOE", DIVIDE ( [@CpoeWeighted], [@CpoeAtt] ),
    "EPA", [@EPA],
    "EPAPerPlay", DIVIDE ( [@EPA], [@Dropbacks] )
)
ORDER BY [EPA] DESC
